item: 6 runs vs the paper's accession list
question: The Data Availability statement lists NCBI accession numbers (four per the extracted text; SRR13312968-72, five, per the PMC web page) but the project has six runs (SRR13312968-73), and the paper says 'six runs'.
proposed_answer: Keep all six (three 5 C, three 22 C; BioSample aliases M3d51-53 and M3dc1-3 cover exactly 3 + 3 and PCA in the paper shows three replicates). SRR13312973 (control replicate 1, M3dc1) is probably the one the statement omits.
evidence: accessions_resolved.tsv note; Results: 'A total of 55.14 GB clean data were produced by six runs ... three replicates of each sample'; ENA PRJNA686250 lists SRR13312968-SRR13312973.
